```json
{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The people of Puerto Rico deserve self-determination on the issue of status.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats are committed to helping Puerto Rico rebuild and recover from the devastation wrought by Hurricanes Irma and Maria and the recent earthquakes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will mobilize resources across the federal government to address Puerto Rico's disparities in energy, infrastructure, health care, education, housing, agriculture, employment, and disaster preparedness.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Disaster response in Puerto Rico must be given the same priority and be conducted on the same basis as federal responses to natural disasters elsewhere in the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will forgive disaster relief loans issued to Puerto Rican municipalities following Hurricanes Irma and Maria to help expedite the island's economic recovery.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The unequal treatment of Puerto Rico's residents must end.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will invest in Puerto Rico's future through economic development initiatives, increased education funding, construction of affordable housing, and innovative energy and climate resilience programs.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats support accelerating access to disaster recovery funds so Puerto Rico can improve its infrastructure and transform itself into one of the fastest-growing, most prosperous parts of the United States.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe Puerto Rico should be treated equally with respect to federal programs, including Medicaid, SNAP, and the Child Tax Credit.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
